newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Mosenergo Jan-Sept pretax profit rises.
newsitem.headline: Mosenergo Jan-Sept pretax profit rises.

text.p: Nine months ended September 30 (billion roubles except where specified)

NOTES - Full name OAO Energetiki i Elektrifikatsii Mosenergo 0#MSNG.RUO. Electricity figures in kilowatt-hours, heating figure in gigacalories. 1995 comparisons for electricity and heating production show percentage change in 1996 over 1995 period.
At the end of the third quarter, 70 percent of consumed energy had been paid for. Mosenergo said it did not owe any back taxes or back wages.
Unified Energy Systems (UES) owns 49 percent of Mosenergo, employees and management 13 percent.

These figures are not prepared to international accounting standards but to Russian accounting standards, which differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. These accounts have been prepared on a cash, not accruals, basis. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
Dollar on Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange (MICEX):
Consumer prices in September 1996 were 16.5 percent higher than in December 1995. In September 1995 they were 104.7 percent higher than in December 1994.
